problem: Root cause narrowed to the shared reusable frontend deploy: the build step writes release-sha.txt with printf '%s\\n', producing a literal backslash-n suffix instead of a newline. The public health assertion requires exactly 40 hex characters, so it rejects the newly activated release and the deploy rolls back to the previous release.
impact: Validated producer onboarding and activation changes are repeatedly rolled back even though build, Lighthouse and atomic activation succeed, preventing reliable production delivery and measurement of activation/MRR effects.

implementation.required_fix: Write the marker with printf '%s\n' so release-sha.txt contains only the 40-character SHA plus a real line terminator.
